claims.claim: Very neat 2 seater couch for sale
claims.evidence: Photos show a cream 2 seater sofa but do not confirm neatness.
Age and purchase date are not shown and cannot be determined from photos.
Close-up shows texture but does not confirm the absence of stains, especially hidden ones.
Close-up shows armrest and cushion texture but does not confirm the absence of tears.
Foam firmness is tactile and not shown in photos.
Smoke exposure is not shown and cannot be determined from photos.

risks.risk: Photos are watermarked and may not depict the actual sofa for sale.
risks.proof: A video of the sofa in the seller's home with a handwritten note showing today's date.
risks.if_unproven: as an item that may not match the photos

risks.risk: Age of the sofa is unknown; the purchase date claim cannot be verified.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the purchase receipt or invoice.

risks.risk: Structural condition of the frame is unknown.
risks.proof: Video of the sofa being sat on and lifted to show the legs and underside.

risks.risk: Hidden stains or odors may be present.
risks.proof: Close-up video of all cushions and seams under bright light.

risks.risk: Exposure to smoke or pets is unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up video of the fabric surface and crevices to check for pet hair or smoke residue.
risks.if_unproven: as exposed to smoke or pets

risks.proof: Video of someone pressing the seat cushions.
risks.if_unproven: as having soft or degraded foam

proof_requests: Video of the sofa in the seller's home with a handwritten note showing today's date
Screenshot of the purchase receipt or invoice
Video pressing the seat cushions to show foam firmness
Video of the underside and frame
Close-up video of all seams and cushions under bright light
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a cream 2 seater sofa, so it can be priced at its worst case while unverified claims and hidden risks remain open.
